methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Requirements for a unified energy data information model are presented in this paper.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents requirements for an energy-data communication information model, not an EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Therefore, this paper aims to solve this problem by providing requirements for the UEDIM, as a basis for subsequent modeling and implementation.

stage1.notes: UEDIM standardises communication semantics for energy data; it does not present or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.
